commentaries.quote: Every life and every good story has tension that comes from not knowing the outcome of the branching future. Striving for a particular branch is the core of the challenge.
Our ability to handle life's challenges is a measure of our strength of character.
Obstacles don't have to stop you. If you run into a wall, don't turn around and give up. Figure out how to climb it, go through it, or work around it.
If there is no struggle, there is no progress.

There are many inspiring quotes about self-improvement through competition and in trying to control the future. These have truth and value, but there's also value in knowing when to let the future take care of itself.
